relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the SNL group, the expression of TLR4 in the dorsal root ganglion of the GBP group was significantly decreased (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: MWT and TWL in the GBP group were higher than those in the SNL group at 5 and 7 days after the operation (all P < 0.05).

key_findings: Gabapentin raised thresholds and reduced DRG TLR4 expression in SNL rats.
